Alisha (PM): Quick sync — I want to land a clear phased plan for the 'stitching' effort: multi-region routing + tenant isolation. Customers keep asking for predictable latency + residency guarantees. Can we sketch acceptance criteria and a rollout path?

Diego (Eng): +1. Need to call out capacity assumptions (N+1), KV cache warmers, and fallback behavior. Also how we treat model-variant fallbacks across regions.

Maya (Eng-Platform): Proposal idea: 4 phases — 1) experimental guardrails (non-prod), 2) pilot with a handful of tenants (opt-in), 3) broader opt-in with policy templates, 4) default-on but reversible. Each phase gated by telemetry (p50/p95/p99, error %), and a tenant-eviction playbook.

Sam (Product): We should define customer-facing commitments per phase: e.g., Pilot = "regional-affinity with best-effort residency", GA = "p99 < X ms within region or failover to backup region with TTL X". Also call out pricing/discount impacts for reserved capacity customers.

Diego (Eng): Technical constraints: cross-region KV sync is expensive; we should avoid active-active KV across regions for now. Use per-region prefix caching + async replication for metadata. That implies some eventual-consistency guarantees for routing updates.

Alisha (PM): Good — can you list concrete gating metrics for phase transitions? Also need a clear ops rollback path and who owns runbook.

Maya (Eng-Platform): Suggested gating:
- Perf: region p95 token latency < 2x baseline for 95% of tenants for 7d
- Errors: < 0.2% 5xxs from routing/fallback code for 24h
- Cost: unit-cost delta < 20% for pilot tenants (otherwise need opt-in billing)
- Telemetry quality: prefix cache hit rate > 70% for production traffic
- Security: KMS audit logs enabled in pilot tenants

Diego (Eng): Ops rollback primitives: feature-flag by tenant, route-level kill-switch, and automated fallback to hosted model variant in original region. Example flag names: `routing.stitch.v1`, `routing.fallback.to-hosted`.

Sam (Product): Customer asks to add a "dedicated affinity" toggle for enterprise accounts (pin to region, reserved capacity). We should include SLA thresholds and a cost/commitment alignment doc in the pilot invite.

Alisha (PM): Who will own the canary? I propose Platform team owns cluster-level rollout, Eng owns runtime changes, Product owns customer gating and comms.

Maya (Eng-Platform): Agree. Platform will run the canary cluster and telemetry dashboards. We should add an early experiment that only routes low-QPS tenants to avoid large blast radius.

Diego (Eng): Routing policy precedence draft (example):
```
1. tenant.pin_region -> route to pinned region
2. tenant.policy.affinity -> prefer region unless capacity < threshold
3. global.fallback -> send to cheapest compatible variant
```
We need to formalize threshold values and how to detect "capacity < threshold" (node util, queue length, or latency signal).

Sam (Product): Also add a customer-visible "residency state" API so customers can monitor where their traffic is served. That reduces support load.

Alisha (PM): Action items:
- Diego: draft runtime feature PR and define threshold heuristics (due EOW)
- Maya: create pilot infra config + dashboards and a template canary playbook (due next Wed)
- Sam: draft pilot invite + SLAs and pricing notes (due EOW)
- Alisha: write acceptance checklist and ops playbook (TBD by next planning sync)

infra-bot: deploy-canary-cluster v2 started (cluster-id: canary-eu-01) :rocket:

Diego (Eng): One more thing — we should add a cheap simulation harness to estimate cross-region cost before enrolling tenants. I'll add a small loadgen + cost model script.

Maya (Eng-Platform): Agreed. Also let's ensure roll-forward is possible: if a policy causes perf regressions, we auto-cut traffic back to original routing within 2min. Need a control-plane hook.

Sam (Product): For pilot tenant selection: prefer mid-size customers (10-50 rps) with diverse models. Flag any compliance/regulatory tenants as excluded.

Alisha (PM): Sounds good. We'll review PRs and pilot plan next Tuesday 09:30 PT. If anyone can't make it, ping me. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

infra-bot: canary-cluster canary-eu-01 health: GREEN (services: router, cache, telemetry)

Diego (Eng): Uploaded initial PR to `github.com/redwood-inference/routing` -> `stitching/phase1` for review. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing/pull/412

Maya (Eng-Platform): Created dashboard draft: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd123/stitching-pilot

Sam (Product): Draft pilot invite posted in drive: https://redwood.app/drive/pilot-invite-v1 (will iterate)

Alisha (PM): Great work. We'll call out dependencies in the tech spec: network egress, KMS per-region, and reserved capacity contracts. Meeting adjourned.
